drafts.title: A Story of Kindness, Courage, and Belonging.
drafts.body:
Meet Jordan, a cautious but gentle dog whose hopeful journey offers families a warm way to talk about patience, kindness, trust, and belonging. This illustrated read-aloud is intended for children ages 3–8 and invites caring conversations without minimizing the time a cautious animal may need to feel safe.

Jordan and the Fosters is available in paperback, hardcover, and digital editions.

"Joe Dinicola tells a tale that would likely inspire a child and parent to explore ways to express care for others."
— Constance Stadler, Readers’ Favorite

approved_facts_used: Jordan is a cautious but gentle dog who has survived life on the streets. When he enters the care of the Foster family, he struggles to trust others and feel that he belongs. After finding his permanent home, Jordan carries those lessons forward by welcoming other foster dogs. The story celebrates the journey from isolation to belonging and shows how kindness can inspire hope for others.

drafts.title: When Patience Helps Trust Grow
drafts.body:
How can we help children understand that cautious animals may need patience before they feel safe?

For Jordan, trust does not arrive all at once. This cautious but gentle dog slowly discovers friendship, courage, and belonging with the Foster family, offering a hopeful starting point for conversations about giving animals the understanding and time they may need. Jordan and the Fosters is an illustrated read-aloud for children ages 3–8 and the parents and caregivers who share stories with them.
